bienvenida.contacto.cuentas: Access accounts are created by Strategic for each client when their solution goes live.
bienvenida.contacto.texto: Tell us about your company and we'll prepare a no-obligation quote.
bienvenida.contacto.titulo: Want to know how Strategic fits your business?
bienvenida.hero.texto: We build a data analysis, forecasting, competitive intelligence and automation platform for your company, connected to the systems you already use.
bienvenida.mision.texto: To boost the growth of e‑commerce SMEs, helping them improve their performance, efficiency and decision-making based on their own information.
bienvenida.nosotros.texto1: Strategic develops software solutions for data analysis, competitive intelligence and process automation for e‑commerce businesses. We currently operate mainly in Argentina, helping businesses better understand their information and adapt to a dynamic, ever-changing market.
bienvenida.nosotros.texto2: Our goal is for every client to make the most of their own information to improve their performance and competitiveness.
bienvenida.nosotros.texto3: We don't offer a generic platform: we start from a base platform that we adapt to each business's processes and goals, delivering solutions aligned with each company's needs.
bienvenida.nosotros.titulo: A software factory specialized in e‑commerce data
bienvenida.paso.cotizacion.texto: We present a proposal with the recommended plan and the scope of the implementation.
bienvenida.paso.desarrollo.texto: We adapt the platform to your business, connect it to your systems and load your data so you can start working with it.
bienvenida.paso.puestaEnMarcha.texto: We create your team's accounts, the subscription starts and we support you along the way.
bienvenida.paso.relevamiento.texto: We learn about your business, your platforms and the goals you want to reach.
bienvenida.pilar.acompanamiento.texto: We stay with the solution after go-live and keep evolving it with you.
bienvenida.pilar.empresas.texto: Designed for SMEs with digital maturity looking to boost their business.
bienvenida.pilar.empresas.titulo: For companies that want to grow
bienvenida.pilar.integrado.texto: We connect to your systems to work with your sales, product and stock data.
bienvenida.pilar.medida.texto: Every solution is built around your business's real needs.
bienvenida.plan.basico.descripcion: To start making decisions with data.
bienvenida.plan.max.descripcion: For companies looking for a comprehensive, strategic solution.
bienvenida.plan.pro.descripcion: To boost your business with AI and tailored automations.
bienvenida.plan.pro.item1: Advanced forecasts and generative AI recommendations
bienvenida.plan.pro.item2: Automations with custom rules and workflows
bienvenida.planes.nota: The implementation price may vary depending on the project's complexity, the number of data sources to integrate, the volume of information and the specific features you need.
bienvenida.planes.texto: Reference prices in US dollars. The final quote is put together for your project.
bienvenida.planes.titulo: Choose the level your business needs
bienvenida.proceso.texto: Since every implementation is tailor-made, it isn't bought with a click: first we get to know your business.
bienvenida.servicio.automatizaciones.tex: Repetitive tasks that run on their own, with rules adapted to your operation.
bienvenida.servicio.competencia.texto: Monitoring of your competitors' prices and listings so you can react in time.
bienvenida.servicio.dashboard.texto: Sales, stock and profitability in one place, with clear and up-to-date indicators.
bienvenida.servicio.integracion.texto: Connection with your e‑commerce platform and systems to centralize your information.
bienvenida.servicio.predicciones.texto: Models that anticipate demand and sales so you can plan ahead.
bienvenida.servicio.recomendaciones.text: Concrete suggestions on prices, stock and products, generated from your data.
bienvenida.servicios.titulo: Everything your business needs to decide with data
bienvenida.vision.texto: To become one of the leading data analysis, competitive intelligence and automation solutions for e‑commerce in Latin America.
